programs.statusNote: Registrations are paused after delivery partner Yarra Energy Foundation entered voluntary administration (ASIC notice 10 Nov 2026). Only insulation and draught-proofing registrations lodged before 19 Oct 2026 continue.

programs.name: Hume Household Energy Officer (Energy Bill Support)

programs.statusNote: Program registrations are paused after delivery partner Yarra Energy Foundation entered voluntary administration (ASIC notice 10 Nov 2026).

programs.name: Macedon Ranges Heat Pump Hot Water Bulk Buy
programs.statusNote: Closed to new enquiries on 31 Oct 2026; installations for existing bookings end 30 Nov 2026.

programs.name: Council Home Energy Program

programs.name: City of Whittlesea Home Energy Program
programs.statusNote: Council-supported home energy advice and upgrade subsidies run until June 2027 or until funding is exhausted.

programs.name: City of Casey DIY Draught-Proofing Rebate
programs.statusNote: Council rebate for eligible DIY draught-proofing products purchased and installed by City of Casey residents (one claim per household).

programs.name: Electric Homes Program 2026–27
programs.statusNote: Community-council bulk-buy and advice program across Greater Geelong, Surf Coast, Golden Plains, Colac Otway and Queenscliffe (expressions of interest opened 5 Oct 2026).

programs.name: Goulburn Murray Solar Savers
programs.statusNote: Vetted-provider program for solar, batteries, heat pump hot water, split systems, insulation, draught proofing and home energy assessments across seven GMCA councils (Feb 2026 notice).
